detail.longDescription:
SSH Client - Terminal is a powerful and easy-to-use remote server management app designed for developers, system administrators, and IT professionals.
Securely connect to your servers from anywhere using SSH and manage files effortlessly with built-in SFTP support.

Key Features:
• SSH Terminal Access
Connect to remote Linux/Unix servers with a fast and reliable terminal experience.

• SFTP File Management
Upload, download, move, rename, and manage server files securely.

• SSH Key Manager
Import, organise, and manage private/public SSH keys for secure authentication.

• Save Command Snippets
Store frequently used commands and execute them quickly.

• Multiple Server Connections
Manage multiple hosts and switch between servers easily.

• Secure Authentication
Supports password login and SSH key-based authentication.

• Clean & User-Friendly Interface
Built for both beginners and advanced users.

Perfect For:
Developers
DevOps Engineers
System Administrators
Website Owners
IT Professionals

Manage your servers on the go with a secure and professional SSH experience.
